stem: In Space Invaders, what happens to the invaders still on screen as the player picks off more of them?
explanation: It began as a hardware quirk: with fewer aliens to draw, the processor moved the survivors more quickly. Its designer, Tomohiro Nishikado, liked the rising tension and kept it.

claims.text: In Space Invaders, released in 1978, the remaining invaders speed up as more of them are destroyed.
In Space Invaders, shot aliens do not make the others split in two, change colour or stop firing.
The speed-up came from the hardware: with fewer aliens to draw on screen, the game could move the rest faster.
Space Invaders was designed by Tomohiro Nishikado, who kept the speed-up as a feature because it raised the tension.
